282:t_10:19.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Huh? But can I really help?」

282:t_10:21.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「That's my specialty! The most exciting part is before people become a couple, isn't it?」

282:t_10:22.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Like $$グレイス#feldt$$ and $$セイエイ$$, $$リンクス$$ and $$ザビ$$, or $l and Miss $$西条$$...」

282:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no... Someone asked me to investigate how your esteemed parents first fell in love, $$ミレイナ$$.」

282:t_10:26.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Come to think of it, I don't know either.」

282:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's discuss something else. Tell me straight: who has caught your eye, $$ミレイナ$$?」

282:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Tell me with that cute little mouth of yours.」

282:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I could always interrogate you. With the nasty methods I learned at $$ＤＥＭ$$.」

282:t_10:31.en:
$$イアン$$
「You sexual-harassment robot! Lay a finger on $$ミレイナ$$ and I'll never forgive you!」

282:t_10:33.en:
$$イアン$$
「A robot like you has no business calling me Dad!」

282:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How cruel! $$ミレイナ$$ might fall in love with someone who isn't human!」

282:t_10:35.en:
$$イアン$$
「I don't care if they're human, a robot, or anything else, as long as it's not you! Anyone but you!」

282:t_10:36.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah, stop! Please don't take me apart!」

282:t_10:37.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Sigh... Once Dad gets like this, there's no stopping him...」

282:t_10:38.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Then we'll make an exception and run the shop today! Let's give it our all...!」

283:t_000:0.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Where are $$刹那$$ and $$ティエリア$$?」

283:t_000:1.en:
$$フェルト$$
「They're at the base for their machines' final adjustments.」

283:t_001:1.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「So these are the kind the $$トップレス$$ fought. They sure are different from the ones we saw in the galaxy.」

283:t_001:2.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Either way, they're our enemies! Order all units to launch!」

283:t_002:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「Good grief... We come back to the solar system and get a rough welcome.」

283:t_002:1.en:
$$ラルク$$
「$$ニコラ$$... Where were you sending that transmission?」

283:t_002:4.en:
$$チコ$$
「Cut it out, Princess, $$ニコラ$$. The $$宇宙怪獣$$ are right in front of us.」

283:t_002:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I know. Fighting them is our job.」

283:t_002:7.en:
$$ルカ$$
「Judging by its course, that $$ツインテール級$$ seems to be targeting the $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ base.」

283:t_002:8.en:
$$シン$$
「If they destroy it now, we'll be stranded at $$木星$$ this time!」

283:t_002:9.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We'll protect the base at all costs.」

283:t_003:0.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Sorry, monsters. I can't let you have that base.」

283:t_003:2.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「I can't look bad with her watching.」

283:t_003:4.en:
$$いぶき$$
「Though $$赤木$$ is always fired up without anyone like that, which is impressive in its own way.」

283:t_004:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「$$バナージ$$... Is $$刹那$$ still unable to launch?」

283:t_004:1.en:
$$バナージ$$
「He says he needs a little more time. Until then, he's leaving it to us.」

283:t_004:2.en:
$$シャア$$
「Then we must live up to his expectations.」

283:t_004:3.en:
$$ガロード$$
「We finally made it back to the solar system! It'd all be pointless if $$バアル$$ got us now!」

283:t_004:4.en:
$$勝平$$
「Yeah! I don't care if you're the force that seeks to vanish or whatever! Don't think you can wipe us out!」

283:t_004:5.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, begin your attack! Remember, the base is behind us!」

283:t_004:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Here I come, $$宇宙怪獣$$! I won't let you have your way!」

283:t_005:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「All units, stay alert! Reinforcements incoming!」

283:t_006:0.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「We'll have to teach them that sending more won't do them any good.」

283:t_006:1.en:
$$タケル$$
「Wait, $$ニコラ$$! Something else is about to happen...!」

283:t_007:0.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Rapid distortion of the dimensional boundary confirmed! Something is warping into this sector!」

283:t_007:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「$$インベーダー#robot$$s...!? Or $$バジュラ$$...!?」

283:t_008:1.en:
$$ブレラ$$
「A machine... Though it looks more like a lump of metal...」

283:t_010:0.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「An attack!? It looked like it bit them!?」

283:t_010:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「It's eating into the $$宇宙怪獣$$...!」

283:t_010:2.en:
$$キラ$$
「That unknown... It's trying to fuse with its target!」

283:t_010:3.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Fuse...! You mean it's trying to absorb it!?」

283:t_010:4.en:
$$ランド$$
「It looks like $$キラ$$ was right!」

283:t_011:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It couldn't withstand that unknown's assimilation!」

283:t_012:1.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「I suppose they decided even they couldn't handle that thing.」

283:t_012:2.en:
$$シモン$$
「Who knows? Maybe they just left us to deal with it.」

283:t_012:3.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Then we have to fight those things!?」

283:t_012:4.en:
$$ダリー$$
「They look ready to attack us!」

283:t_012:5.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Their course is confirmed! The unknowns are targeting the $$ソレスタルビーイング$$ base!」

283:t_012:6.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「We'll have to intercept them.」

283:t_012:7.en:
$$ランド$$
「Hold on! How do we handle the way they fight!?」

283:t_012:8.en:
$$メール$$
「What'll happen to us if they absorb us...!?」

283:t_012:9.en:
$$レド$$
「But we have to fight... To survive...!」

283:t_012:11.en:
$$オズマ$$
「All units, we have no choice! Steel yourselves!」

283:t_012:12.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「We can't let them reach the base!」
